boot_auth.digest: sha256(domain || method || path || sha256(body)): domain the ASCII bytes of domain, method "POST", path the request path, both UTF-8, sha256(body) the 32 raw bytes of the body's digest; concatenated with no separators
boot_auth.signature: Ed25519 (RFC 8032, deterministic) over the 32-byte digest, as base64url without padding

boot_test_key.seed: sha256 of seed_preimage (UTF-8): the Ed25519 private key's 32-byte seed
boot_test_key.seed_preimage: trustedrouter authorize vectors v1 boot TEST key; not a secret
